title: Start here — WebDAV v0.1-dev5
summary: The canonical WebDAV package is packages/oorexx_webdav at v0.1-dev5. dev5 adds abort-safe staged streaming publication, durable collection dead properties and qualified AWSTAPE representation while retaining dev4 locks, sync REPORT, Range and bounded StorageByteSource support.
invariants: WebDAV paths are Storage namespace projections, not host filesystem identity.
StorageRef remains object identity; WebDAV representation is not object identity.
A partial or disconnected streaming upload must never acquire a DAV path or catalogue-admitted Storage object.
HTTPS owns transport; WebDAV owns DAV semantics; Storage owns object/namespace/verification/commit semantics.
